about.title: About OpenPlay Games
about.subtitle: An Open Source HTML5 Game Discovery Platform
about.intro.title: 🌐 About
about.intro.p1: OpenPlay Games is a platform dedicated to curating and showcasing open-source HTML5 games from GitHub. Our mission is to help more people discover and enjoy quality open-source games, while providing a window for open-source developers to showcase their work.
about.intro.p2: All games on this site come from the GitHub open-source community and follow their respective open-source licenses (MIT, BSD, Apache-2.0, etc.). We only include projects with clear open-source licenses, respecting every developer's work.
about.intro.p3: Whether you're looking for a classic game to relax or want to learn from HTML5 game source code, you'll find what you need here.
about.opensource.title: 📜 Open Source Statement
about.opensource.p1: OpenPlay Games itself is also an open-source project. The source code is hosted on GitHub, and anyone is welcome to view, learn from, and contribute.
about.opensource.p2: Each game page on this site clearly marks:
about.opensource.p3: All game copyrights belong to their original authors. This site only collects and displays them, claiming no copyright over any game content.
about.dmca.title: ⚖️ DMCA Notice
about.dmca.p1: We respect intellectual property rights. If you are the original author of a game and believe that your work has been included on this site without proper authorization, please contact us.
about.dmca.p2: We promise to remove the relevant content within 48 hours upon receiving a valid copyright complaint.
about.dmca.p3: Please provide the following when contacting us:
about.dmca.item2: Detailed description of the copyrighted work
about.dmca.item3: Specific page URL on this site
about.dmca.item4: A statement that you are the copyright owner or authorized representative
about.privacy.title: 🔒 Privacy Policy
about.privacy.p1: We take your privacy seriously. We promise:
about.privacy.item1: We do not collect personal information
about.privacy.item2: We do not use tracking scripts or analytics tools
about.privacy.item3: We do not set cookies (unless future ad platforms do)
about.privacy.item4: All games run locally, no user data is uploaded
about.privacy.p2: If Google AdSense is integrated in the future, Google may use cookies for personalized ads. We will update this policy accordingly.
